Name: Holiday Shop Music
Author: nancyxdrewx
Description: Adds a festive music track to Pierre's and Joja Mart during fall and winter. If the extra added realism isn't to your taste there's a config option to turn it off in fall. A quick and silly idea, may expand on the music choice. Compatible with SVE.

Downloads.Description: Adds cheer to your holiday shopping.
